subject: HSM access matrix & rotation snapshot for Zenith Capital - SOC 2 / SIG evidence
messages:
From: Emily Carver <emily.carver@zenith-cap.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@zenith-cap.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: HSM access matrix + rotation snapshot for upcoming SOC2 / SIG review

Hi Sofia,

We're working through Zenith Capital's vendor evidence collection for an upcoming SOC 2 audit and SIG review. As part of our crypto controls assessment we need the following artifacts from Redwood for the tenant/account mapped to Zenith Capital: 

- HSM/KMS access matrix (users, roles, service principals; last update timestamp) covering all principal accounts that have key unwrapping or administrative privileges. CSV preferred.
- Rotation snapshot: a tarball containing rotation metadata for the last 90 days (rotation events, job IDs, operator identity, UTC timestamps).
- A short sample of rotation logs (text) showing the sequence of operations for at least one scheduled rotation with redactions for PII.
- A brief evidence manifest (1 page) describing how keys are backed by HSM or KMS, in-transit encryption, and where backup key material is stored.

Please also include checksums (SHA256) for any archives, and indicate whether any of the keys were wrapped using customer-managed keys (BYOK) or Redwood-managed KEKs. We need these items by EOD Friday (72 hours) if possible to stay on track with our audit window.

If there are any restrictions on what can be shared, or if you prefer an encrypted transfer mechanism (SFTP, presigned S3 link with limited TTL), let me know.

Thanks,
Emily Carver
Head of Vendor Security
Zenith Capital
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carver <emily.carver@zenith-cap.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM access matrix + rotation snapshot for upcoming SOC2 / SIG review

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver everything you've asked for within the 72-hour window. High-level plan below; I'll coordinate delivery once we have the artifact bundle ready.

Plan & next steps:
- Irene will pull the HSM/KMS access matrix and rotation metadata from our audit pipeline and HSM escrow logs. We'll include role mappings and last-modified timestamps.
- We will produce a rotation_snapshot tarball containing a machine-readable JSON manifest, rotation event records, and a compressed sample of rotation logs. All operator identities will be redacted to role-level (e.g., \"rotation-operator: key-ops-team\").
- We'll provide SHA256 checksums for each file and a one-page evidence_manifest.md explaining: at-rest encryption, in-transit TLS+mutual auth, HSM vendor details (CloudHSM/Thales option where applicable), and BYOK flags for tenant-level keys.
- Delivery method: presigned S3 links with 7-day TTL and one-time download protections, or SFTP if you prefer. We will include a DocuSign attestation if Zenith requires a signed statement.

Open items for you: does Zenith require operator-level identities (unredacted) under the data-sharing agreement, or are role-level redactions acceptable for SOC2 / SIG? Also confirm whether Zenith needs the artifacts notarized (DocuSign).

Irene — can you start pulling logs and build the artifact bundle (see attachment naming below)? Jonas, looping you in for timeline/contract confirmation in case we need an expanded NDA for unredacted operator audit trails.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: hsm_access_matrix_zenith.csv (stub), rotation_snapshot_20270831.tar.gz (stub)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM access matrix + rotation snapshot for upcoming SOC2 / SIG review

Thanks Sofia — starting work now. Notes on collection and redaction plan so reviewers have context: 

Collection sources and filters:
- HSM provider(s): AWS CloudHSM (tenant keys) + internal Vault-HSM-wrapped KEK (for platform service keys).
- Logs pulled from rotation job runner (k8s cronjob controller) and centralized audit pipeline (immutable append-only store).
- Time window: 2027-06-01 to 2027-08-31 (90 days) — matches your request.

Redaction policy:
- Operator identity: will be redacted to role@team (e.g., key-ops) unless Emily confirms they require unredacted usernames.
- IP addresses: last octet replaced with x (10.11.12.x).
- No customer data is present in rotation logs; still scanning for any artifact that may have keys in plaintext (none expected).

Artifact list and format (will be attached to delivery manifest):
- hsm_access_matrix_zenith.csv — columns: principal, role, privilege, last_granted_iso, source_system
- rotation_snapshot_20270831.tar.gz — contains rotation_manifest.json, rotation_event_records/*.json.gz
- rotation_log_sample.txt — redacted stream of one rotation event with timestamps and operation statuses
- evidence_manifest.md — short narrative + SHA256 checksums

I will produce SHA256 checksums and a short checklist for the auditor. Expected ETA for artifact generation: 2027-09-08 13:00 PDT. I will upload to a presigned S3 path and share link in the final email.

-Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Commands / internal notes (for traceability):
# gather rotation events
# (internal) curl -s \"https://audit.redwood.internal/api/rotation?tenant=zenith&from=2027-06-01&to=2027-08-31\" > rotation_events_raw.ndjson
# scrub identity fields, compress to rotation_event_records/
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carver <emily.carver@zenith-cap.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM access matrix + rotation snapshot for upcoming SOC2 / SIG review

Emily — attaching the artifact bundle for Zenith's audit team. Delivery notes below and a short summary of what's included.

Delivery method: Presigned S3 bundle (one-time download, 7-day TTL) — link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/zenith/hsm-evidence-20270907 (access restricted; please request an access key if you cannot download).

Included artifacts (attached):
- hsm_access_matrix_zenith.csv — role-level mappings exported from IAM and Vault (columns: principal, role, privilege, last_granted_iso, source).
- rotation_snapshot_20270831.tar.gz — rotation_manifest.json + compressed event records (90-day window).
- rotation_log_sample.txt — redacted sample with operation sequence and status codes.
- evidence_manifest.md — one-page narrative describing at-rest encryption, in-transit protections (mutual TLS), HSM vendor deployments and whether tenant keys are BYOK. Also includes SHA256 checksums:
  - hsm_access_matrix_zenith.csv: SHA256=3f8b1e8f... (truncated)
  - rotation_snapshot_20270831.tar.gz: SHA256=8a2c9b5d... (truncated)
  - rotation_log_sample.txt: SHA256=4c1d2e7a... (truncated)

Key points:
- Tenant keys for Zenith are customer-isolated in a dedicated KMS partition; KEKs for platform services are HSM-wrapped with strict role-based access.
- Rotations are orchestrated by an auditable scheduled job; all rotation events are immutably recorded in the audit pipeline.
- We have redacted operator identities to role-level for privacy; if Zenith requires operator-level identities we can deliver them but will need an approved data-sharing addendum + NDA amendment.

Links / references: HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/zenith-record-5421 | Internal tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1347

If you confirm receipt and whether you need unredacted operator info or a DocuSign attestation, we will follow up with the signed manifest.

Thanks and let me know if anything else is required for the SOC2 / SIG packet.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

- hsm_access_matrix_zenith.csv (attachment: text/csv; stub)
